∀ (n : Nat) (la : n.Partition) (σ : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)),
  Eq.{1}
    (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (Units.val.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} Equiv.Perm.sign.{0} Fin.revPerm))
      (Etingof.spechtModuleCharacter n la σ))
    (MvPolynomial.coeff.{0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.Nat.Partition.toFinsupp la) (Etingof.rhoShift n))
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.vandermondePoly n) (Etingof.cycleTypePsumProduct n σ)))

∀ {n N : Nat} (la : n.Partition) (σ : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)),
  LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} la.sortedParts) N →
    Eq.{1}
      (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (Units.val.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} Equiv.Perm.sign.{0} Fin.revPerm))
        (Etingof.spechtModuleCharacter n la σ))
      (MvPolynomial.coeff.{0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.Nat.Partition.toFinsuppN N la) (Etingof.rhoShift N))
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.vandermondePoly N) (Etingof.cycleTypePsumProductN N n σ)))

source_text: For every N at least the number of rows of lambda, the Specht character is the x^(lambda+rho_N) coefficient of the N-variable Vandermonde times the cycle-type power-sum product.
